description: Lists services (activity types) from mite, active ones or with `archived: true` the archived ones; use it to look up service ids for filters such as `service_id` in `mite_list_time_entries`. Returns id, name, billable flag, archived flag and note per service. The whole list is returned at once without paging.

archived.description: true = list archived entries instead of the active ones, e.g. true. Default: false.

name: mite_list_services
title: List services
